name: Ultimate Metro
summary: Compact two-platform metro terminus for reversible lightrail on ordinary electric tramtrack.
description: Ultimate Metro 0.8.2 adds visible low 80m surface platforms, platform paving, a paved terminus plaza, benches, bins, planters, lighting and decorative overhead wires using installed Urban Games assets. The surface passenger paths are raised to the 25cm platform floor. Vehicle paths, speeds, terminals and the underground station are preserved. Existing stations are not rebuilt automatically; place a new surface station to test the new appearance and passenger access. Both variants use ordinary electric tramtrack and reversible lightrail, with 80 km/h straight station tracks and a 40 km/h crossover. Menu artwork is illustrative. Do not remove the mod while its stations remain.
